definitions.innings: outs / 3; a line of 6.1 is 19 outs
definitions.anchor: pooled: sum of pitches over sum of outs x 3, PA or BF; never an average of player rates
definitions.par: round(100 x rate / anchor), nearest point; not inverted, uncoloured
definitions.team_par: 100 x club unit rate / unweighted mean of the club unit rates
definitions.tracking: usable when every club with 200+ PA sees 3.3+ P/PA; untracked when more than 50% of the PA sit on clubs under that floor; partial otherwise
definitions.role_parity: sp + rp BF within 0.5% of the season-line BF: role_split; within 5%: season_line_fallback; beyond: untracked for P/IP and P/BF, stamped role_split_mismatch

teams.basis: line_team: the club on the player's StatsAPI season or role line (for a player who changed clubs, the line's club). Consumers pass their own membership through team_unit_rates(club_of=...) and team_par().

stability.basis: MLB role lines (sp, rp) and non-pitcher hitting lines, consecutive seasons, the floor met in both
